transitions.off: Scene transitions are not available right now.
transitions.needsTwoScenes: Add a second scene: a transition goes between two scenes.
transitions.footage: This video holds video clips. Until transitions over video clips arrive, the exported video plays a cut where a video clip meets another scene, and an export with other transitions is refused: set cuts there to export.
transitions.footageCut: A scene of this cut holds a video clip, so it plays as a cut, in the preview and in the exported video.
transitions.footageExport: This video holds video clips: until transitions over video clips arrive, its export refuses scene transitions. Set cuts to export it.
transitions.applyTo: {name}: put it between scene {from} and scene {to}
transitions.cardHint: Click to put it on the selected cut, or drag it onto a cut of the timeline
transitions.cutHint: Click to remove the transition of the selected cut
transitions.applyAllNeedsOne: Put a transition on the selected cut first
transitions.hint: Hover a card to preview it. After you apply one, the video plays around the cut. Drag the handle on a cut's chip in the timeline to change its length.
transitions.lengthHandle: Length of the transition into scene {n}
transitions.lengthHint: Drag to change the length (arrow keys: 0.1 s, with Shift: 0.5 s)
transitions.lengthClamped: The scenes next to this cut give {seconds} s at most

animations.selectLayer: Select a text, shape or picture on the canvas to animate it.
animations.motionLayer: A Motion layer moves by its own design: change its energy and pattern under Properties.
animations.videoNotExported: Animations on video clips are not exported yet (the export refuses them). You can remove the ones this clip carries.

slotHints.combo: A short move right after the layer arrives.
slotHints.effect: Runs while the layer is on screen, between In and Out.

animations.effectLength: An effect runs over the layer, between In and Out
animations.extra: {count, plural, one {# more animation} other {# more animations}}
animations.unknownPreset: This slot holds {id}, which this editor cannot show yet.
animations.noRoom: This layer is too short for that. Shorten its other animations or make the layer longer first.
animations.failed: The animation could not be saved. Try again.
animations.fineTune: Change the length and the direction under Properties → Animation.
